##### Project general facts

Miorah Maison by Zoya emerges as a truly exquisite boutique residential development that redefines intimate urban living with its sophisticated low-rise design and uncompromising attention to detail. This stunning building stands as a testament to modern elegance, offering a curated collection of apartments that have been meticulously crafted to provide the perfect sanctuary for discerning residents. Every aspect of this exceptional development has been thoughtfully considered, from the striking architectural lines to the premium rooftop amenities that elevate daily life to new heights of refinement.

The residences at Miorah Maison are presented in a state of complete elegance, with every apartment being fully furnished to the highest standards of taste and quality. Each home has been designed to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating an atmosphere of effortless sophistication that welcomes residents from the moment they step through the door. The thoughtful integration of premium furnishings and finishes ensures that every residence is move-in ready, allowing residents to immediately immerse themselves in the luxury and tranquillity that defines this extraordinary development.

Beyond the exquisite interiors, Miorah Maison offers an exceptional array of rooftop amenities that transform leisure and relaxation into daily pleasures. Residents are invited to indulge in the sparkling swimming pool, maintain their wellness routine at the state-of-the-art gym, host unforgettable gatherings at the barbecue area, and watch their little ones delight in the dedicated kids' zone. This is a place where every detail has been considered to create a harmonious living environment that nurtures connection, wellbeing, and the simple joys of life.
 
##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South stands as one of the city's most visionary and rapidly evolving districts, offering an exceptional environment where modern living meets unparalleled opportunity and connectivity. This dynamic neighbourhood has been master-planned to create a seamless blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, ensuring that every convenience is always within effortless reach. The community's strategic position and forward-thinking design make it an increasingly desirable destination for those seeking both lifestyle excellence and long-term value.

Life within Dubai South is defined by its perfect balance of tranquillity and accessibility, where serene residential streets coexist with vibrant commercial hubs and world-class amenities. The neighbourhood's welcoming atmosphere and reputation as a community of choice for discerning individuals make it an attractive destination for families, professionals, and investors alike. Exceptional connectivity places the vibrant heart of Dubai within effortless reach, while the surrounding environment offers a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle.

The surroundings of Dubai South offer a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle, while major road networks provide seamless access to the city's most prestigious destinations, ensuring that business, education, and leisure are always perfectly balanced. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of suburban living with the dynamic allure of a global metropolis, making Dubai South an ideal location for those seeking a unique and unparalleled living experience.
